world.title: West Asia conflict LIVE: Yemen's Houthis reach strategic island at mouth of Bab al-Mandeb
world.summary: Yemen's Houthi fighters, backed by Iran, have seized a strategic island at the mouth of the Bab al-Mandeb strait. An adviser to Iran’s Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, described this advance as a “resounding victory.” The situation continues to evolve, with updates on the West Asia conflict being reported as of September 11, 2026.

world.title: As US marks 25 years since September 11, Zohran Mamdani launches free online portal for documents, releasing the first 170,000 pages that prove ...
world.summary: As the US commemorates the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has launched a free online portal. This platform features documents related to the long-term health effects of the attacks, with the initial release including 170,000 pages of records. The initiative aims to provide accessible information for those affected.

world.title: BRICS’ share of global GDP set to rise to 28.5% by 2031: the bloc’s economic clout in 5 charts
world.summary: BRICS is projected to increase its share of global GDP to 28.5% by 2031, up from approximately 27% in 2025. The bloc, primarily driven by China's economic strength and India's expanding economy and investments, currently has an economic value of $30.37 trillion compared to the world's $111.6 trillion. IMF forecasts indicate continued growth for BRICS.

business.title: Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon quits over AI safety: What he warned and how OpenAI, Anthropic reacted
business.summary: Jacob Coxon has resigned from Anthropic, citing concerns that AI companies prioritize rapid development over safety, which he believes poses risks to humanity. His departure highlights ongoing debates within the industry regarding the balance between innovation and ethical considerations. Both OpenAI and Anthropic have responded to these concerns, emphasizing their commitment to responsible AI development and safety measures.

business.title: India's forex reserves surge $4.5 billion in a week to record high on robust capital inflows
business.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $4.5 billion in the week ending September 4, reaching a record high of $785.7 billion. This marks the tenth consecutive week of growth, with total reserves rising nearly $120 billion during this period. The surge is attributed to robust capital inflows, bolstered by policy measures aimed at strengthening the country's balance of payments.

business.title: GitLab urges users to patch max severity path traversal flaw
business.summary: GitLab has advised users to urgently patch their servers due to a critical path traversal vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-85706. This maximum-severity flaw was discovered by a security researcher known as 's3ntago' and reported through GitLab's bug bounty program. Users are encouraged to implement the necessary updates to safeguard their systems against potential exploitation.

technology.title: Mercedes-AMG CLE 646 Spezialanfertigung Revealed With 637bhp; Limited to 30 Units
technology.summary: Mercedes-AMG has unveiled the CLE 646 Spezialanfertigung, a limited edition performance coupe featuring a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 engine producing 637bhp. It offers rear-wheel drive, a nine-speed gearbox, and a top speed of 310km/h. Limited to just 30 units, this model is based on the CLE 53 and boasts a wider carbon-fibre body and a minimalist interior.

technology.title: Without The Witcher 3 Remaster, the Songs of the Past Expansion Would Not Have Been Possible - CDPR Reworked Engine and Mechanics
technology.summary: CD Projekt RED stated that the remaster of The Witcher 3 was essential for the development of the upcoming expansion, Songs of the Past. The team enhanced various project aspects to bring their vision to life. This summer, they showcased gameplay for the expansion, which is also known as "Ballads of the Past" in Russian localization.

technology.title: Enterprise AI is waiting for its iPhone moment
technology.summary: The corporate AI market is at a pivotal moment, akin to the early days of the iPhone. Currently, it struggles to gain traction due to visible complexities and challenges. For widespread adoption, a breakthrough is needed that simplifies and conceals these issues, similar to how Apple transformed technology perception with the iPhone's launch in 2007.

sports.title: Kohli charms Shinde with humility in London, shares ideas on sports, youth talent
sports.summary: Virat Kohli met Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde in London, where he showcased his humility. The two discussed various topics, including the development of Maharashtra, the importance of sports, and nurturing youth talent. Additionally, they touched upon Kohli's upcoming milestones in One Day Internationals (ODIs), highlighting the significance of sports in fostering youth engagement and talent development.

sports.title: Power-hitting emerges as Bangladesh women's biggest concern in T20 cricket
sports.summary: The Bangladesh women's cricket team faces significant challenges, primarily due to a lack of power hitters in key batting positions and during crucial death overs. Concerns have also been raised regarding an over-reliance on a few key players, as well as issues related to pace bowling and overall fitness. These factors contributed to their recent exit from international competitions.

sports.title: CSK deny Dhoni bid to buy a stake; but he owns some shares anyway
sports.summary: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) management denied reports that Mahendra Singh Dhoni sought to buy a stake in the franchise. Despite this, Dhoni reportedly holds some shares in CSK. The management is currently awaiting his decision regarding the next steps, particularly in finalizing the new head coach for the team as they prepare for upcoming seasons.

health.title: That 'acidity' could be a heart attack: Medanta cardiologist Dr Nishant Tyagi shares warning signs you shouldn't miss
health.summary: Heart attacks can present with subtle symptoms, including nausea and feelings resembling acidity. Medanta cardiologist Dr. Nishant Tyagi emphasizes the importance of recognizing these warning signs, such as unusual fatigue during exercise or persistent exhaustion. Prompt medical attention is crucial, as early intervention can significantly improve outcomes and potentially save lives. Awareness of these signs is essential for prevention.

health.title: Brain Aneurysms May Be Twice as Common as Thought
health.summary: Unruptured brain aneurysms may affect one in 15 healthy adults, indicating a prevalence more than double that of previous estimates. This finding comes from the largest analysis conducted on the topic, which highlights a significant increase in the occurrence of these aneurysms over the past two decades. The research underscores the need for increased awareness and monitoring.

health.title: Why Bats Don’t Get Sick From Viruses They Carry
health.summary: Scientists have discovered unique immune adaptations in bats that may explain their resistance to viruses they carry without becoming seriously ill. This research offers new insights into the evolution of immune systems and how various animals respond to diseases. Understanding these mechanisms could enhance knowledge of viral infections and inform strategies for managing diseases in other species.

science.title: AI in Science: Ways Artificial Intelligence is Changing Research
science.summary: Artificial Intelligence is revolutionizing scientific research by enhancing data analysis, drug discovery, simulations, climate modeling, genomics, and laboratory automation. AI processes large datasets more quickly than traditional methods, enabling researchers to utilize machine learning algorithms for examining data from experiments, satellites, sensors, and scientific instruments. This transformation accelerates research outcomes and improves efficiency across various scientific disciplines.

science.title: MRI scans minus the loud sound? Scientists develop a new technique to cut noise and stress
science.summary: Researchers at the University of North Carolina School of Medicine have developed a new functional MRI technique called SORDINO, aimed at reducing noise and stress during scans. Published in Nature Neuroscience, this innovation addresses the disruptive loudness of traditional MRI machines, which can reach levels comparable to a power drill or rock concert, potentially affecting brain signal measurements.

science.title: September Skies Reveal Cosmic Wonders
science.summary: September offers sky-watchers a chance to explore the night skies filled with planets, stars, and constellations. This autumn month presents opportunities to observe various cosmic phenomena, enhancing the experience for enthusiasts. The clear skies allow for better visibility of celestial bodies, making it an ideal time for both amateur and seasoned astronomers to engage with the universe's wonders.

entertainment.title: Mythri’s 418 Trailer: Opens The Doors To Hellish Horror
entertainment.summary: Mythri Movie Makers' upcoming horror thriller, "418," is set to release on September 18th. The film is produced by Naveen Yerneni and Yalamanchili Ravi Shankar, with Prashanth Neel presenting it. Kirtan Nadagouda makes his directorial debut with this project. The trailer hints at a chilling narrative, promising to engage audiences with its horror elements and suspenseful storyline.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, September 12, 2026: You may feel ready to stand on your own, trust what you've built
entertainment.summary: On September 12, 2026, horoscopes suggest individuals may feel empowered to embrace independence and trust their personal achievements. Kishori Sud, a spiritual practitioner and intuitive guide with over five years of experience in tarot reading and holistic healing, provides insights for all sun signs. Her background includes roles in advertising and journalism, enhancing her unique perspective in tarot.

entertainment.title: How Neem Karoli Baba became a hit among Hippies and tech titans
entertainment.summary: Neem Karoli Baba, a Hindu spiritual leader born in the early 1900s in Uttar Pradesh, gained a significant following in the US despite never traveling outside India. His ashram, Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand, attracted diverse visitors, including hippies and Silicon Valley figures. The recent success of the film "Hanuman Ansh" has further highlighted his influence and legacy.
